title: Beautiful Spread, just too small.......
text: Beautiful Spread, just too small........ I have reviewed this already, but, I give it 3 stars because the Queen Size is too small for a queen bed.  It is a beautiful spread, I was so disappointed that it was too small for my bed.  It would have been 5 stars if I had not sent it back, because it was too small.
